metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Carl Gustav Jung
records.biography_en: In The Küsnacht Seminar, Carl Gustav Jung takes the role of inquisitive historical analyst. “Draw the image first.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: round wire spectacles, swept gray clay hair, compact tweed collar, red folio.

records.name: Iris Redbook
records.biography_en: In The Küsnacht Seminar, Iris Redbook takes the role of meticulous image recorder. “The red page is still wet.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small red folio open to one simple painted circle.

records.name: Hugo Coincidence
records.biography_en: In The Küsnacht Seminar, Hugo Coincidence takes the role of startled coincidence collector. “Both stopped at once.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two matching pocket watches in one hand, simple cases.

records.name: Mina Towerstone
records.biography_en: In The Küsnacht Seminar, Mina Towerstone takes the role of pensive stone carver. “The stone had another face.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: palm-sized blunt stone block and stubby chisel.

records.name: Otto Imagekeeper
records.biography_en: In The Küsnacht Seminar, Otto Imagekeeper takes the role of curious active-imagination participant. “The bird can have a turn.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one tiny colorful clay bird figurine in cupped hands.

records.name: Perry Quaternity
records.biography_en: In The Küsnacht Seminar, Perry Quaternity takes the role of overzealous pattern finder. “There should be four.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: wood tray with four colored clay quadrants.
